author: Squitmom

title: reliable, functional, humble
body:
this is a quality app that gets the job done. i love and appreciate that it is actually ad-free and built/maintained by an individual female developer— THANK YOU. the app itself maintains a simplicity that is versatile: it removes a direct emphasis on urgency and/or self-competition, but alsooo could easily be used as an encouragement tool for those preferring to reach 100% every day!
the bug fixes are infrequent and, if necessary, productive, actually addressing any bugs that might be present (any of which being hardly noticeable, regardless). 
an app of this quality and simplicity is apparently rare and hard to come by. whenever i recommend this app, i do so with confidence.

title: 9/10 highly recommend
body: I love this app! I love the simplicity but also the customization feature. If you’re a someone who wants to have some control over the look n feel then you’ll like this app. The only thing I wish was a color tuner for the theme color! Not even color choices for your main interface in my opinion but I love the color customization options for each habit and appreciate the feature to reorganize your habits in a list of your preferred sequence. And never once had an add pop up on me or distract my screen. 9/10 app ☑️⭐️
author: Peaprotein

title: Love it, but feature request
body:
Overall, I am thrilled with this app. The simplicity, the daily view and yearly view, the fact that it’s free/no ads (please try to keep it that way as long as possible) :)

Feature request:
Can you make it possible to adjust a habit to only be designated for certain days of the week? 

Example: I want to run 1 mile per day during the week, and skip Saturday + Sunday. But right now it always shows running on Saturday/Sunday which can make it feel like your not sticking to your habit

title: Great for a free app! One small fix…
body:
Works great, does the basic job without a million ads, which is amazing! I love this app to keep track of my habits from week to week. 
Only comment that would make it perfect: I wish there was a way to rearrange the habits once I’ve started tracking. There are some habits I do in the morning and some in the evening, but I did not add them in order. Unfortunately the only way I think I can fix that is by deleting them all and then adding them back in the right order. And I think I will lose my data if I do that.
